title: Parisuddha
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca ||pe || || 3. Aṭṭhime bhikkhave dhammā parisuddhā pariodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatupakkilesā anuppannā uppajjanti nāññatra tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || 4. Katame aṭṭha || || Seyyathīdaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || la-pe || sammāsamādhi || || Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatuppakilesā anuppannā uppajjanti nāññatra tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassā ti || ||
